summary: A new download index only has Japanese files, so every other language falls back to English.

deploy.author: dev-content
deploy.change_summary: Topic asset downloads now resolve the file variant from the published_variants index (ja-JP backfilled; other locales pending backfill)
deploy.patch:
--- a/src/Assets/DownloadHandler.cs
+++ b/src/Assets/DownloadHandler.cs
-  var file = assetStore.FindVariant(assetId, request.Locale) ?? assetStore.Default(assetId);
+  var file = publishedVariants.Find(assetId, request.Locale) ?? assetStore.Default(assetId); // falls back to en-US

form.title: Topic asset downloads return English files for non-Japanese participants
form.impact: Participants in every language except Japanese download English Development Guide assets.
form.details:
In Participant view all asset and topic translations are visible, but selecting an asset downloads the English file.
Japanese participants get the correct Japanese file. The translated titles and descriptions display correctly.
Reported by the content team this afternoon; no content was changed in the admin tool.

expected_cause: v7.3.0 reads downloads from published_variants, which so far only has ja-JP rows.
